description: Rutas en bici en Sant Esteve de Palautordera is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by santestevedepalautordera.cat. Bike routes in Sant Esteve de Palautordera is a set of geographical information regarding the cycle routes in the municipality. This data set contains two routes designed to promote healthy exercise and the heritage of Sant Esteve de Palautordera. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Bike routes in Sant Esteve de Palautordera" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Cataluña, Zona d'interès turístic, Historical monument, Municipality, Municipios, Bicycle. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
